dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: It's partly to clear out the junk in the water and perform underwater reconstruction work. And partly to recover everyone's belongings.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: Loads of valuables belonging to the citizens were washed away. It doesn't matter how much they're actually worth, but they all meant something.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: I'd like to help recover them, if I can.
